pc-link-device.title: Link my profile
pc-link-device.connecting: Connecting… if the server is asleep this can take a minute.
pc-link-device.show: On your other device, scan this code with the camera, or send yourself the link. It works once.
pc-link-device.qr: QR code that links a device to your profile
pc-link-device.enter: Or use the other device's code
pc-link-device.camera-denied: Camera access is blocked. Allow it in your browser, or paste the link.
pc-link-device.camera-missing: No camera found. Paste the link instead.
pc-link-device.camera-failed: The camera didn't start. Paste the link instead.
pc-link-device.notice-invalid: That isn't a papchat device link.
pc-link-device.notice-expired: That link has expired. Make a new one.
pc-link-device.confirm: Check that both devices show this code.
pc-link-device.confirm-named: Linking to {name}. Check that both devices show this code.
pc-link-device.warning: Accept only if you're holding both devices. A linked device can read your chats and be you.
pc-link-device.waiting: Waiting for the other device to accept…
pc-link-device.done: Linked. Both devices are you now.
pc-link-device.failed-server: Couldn't reach the server. Try again in a minute.
pc-link-device.failed-expired: The code expired before another device used it.
pc-link-device.failed-gone: That link has expired or was already used.
pc-link-device.failed-same: That's this same browser: open the link on another device, or in the installed app.
pc-link-device.failed-proof: The other device couldn't prove who it is, so nothing was linked.
